channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Reggie Bullock | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Reggie Bullock from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Monty Williams on Reggie Bullock, Dorian Finney-Smith
item.description:
Monty Williams:

“Finney-Smith is one of the most improved players in the NBA. Doesn't get nearly enough credit for that . . . Bullock is a guy that New York talked about how much they didn't want to lose him and now everybody out in the West is wishing he would have stayed.”

Monty Williams on Reggie Bullock, Dorian Finney-Smith, May 1, 2022. Source: Twitter @townbrad.

item.title: Steve Mills on Reggie Bullock, Dennis Smith
item.description:
From Knicks President Steve Mills:

“Our Knicks family is deeply saddened by the sudden passing of Reggie Bullock and Dennis Smith Jr.’s close family members. At times like this, we are reminded that life is bigger than basketball. Our thoughts are with them and their families.”

Steve Mills on Reggie Bullock, Dennis Smith, Oct 29, 2019. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Scott Perry on Marcus Morris, Reggie Bullock
item.description:
Knicks GM Scott Perry on the signings of Marcus Morris & Reggie Bullock:

“With Reggie & Marcus we are adding two more versatile, hard-nosed & accomplished players to an already improved roster. We value both players' perimeter shooting & their strong presence”

Scott Perry on Marcus Morris, Reggie Bullock, Jul 16, 2019. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Reggie Bullock
item.description:
Aaron McMann:Stan Van Gundy:

“We’re struggling on the Reggie front. We’ve been able to keep the other 13 guys healthy, but the Reggie guys we’re struggling with.”

Stan Van Gundy on Reggie Bullock, Nov 25, 2016. Source: Twitter @AaronMcMann.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Reggie Bullock
item.description:
“Still run our 1-5 pick-and-rolls, and obviously get the ball to our centers down low some. Running a lot of stuff for our forwards, them in pick-and-rolls, them isolating and posting. Trying to run some catch-and-shoots, running KCP and Reggie Bullock off screens.”

Stan Van Gundy on Reggie Bullock, Oct 25, 2016. Source: Booth Newspapers.
